zh.app.title: MCP × vLEI 互動展示
zh.app.subtitle: AI agent 代表公司呼叫政府系統時，怎麼證明「是哪個法人、什麼角色、經誰授權」
zh.banner.simulated: 模擬環境：勞保申報為模擬，未連接勞工保險局。所有身分都是虛構的。信任根為示範而自行架設。KERI 金鑰日誌、ACDC 憑證與撤銷都是真的。
zh.who.title: 誰在呼叫
zh.who.note: 法人把「勞保申報」角色授權給經辦人（角色憑證 ECR）；經辦人再在自己的金鑰事件日誌裡，把代理權委任給 agent（KERI 委任，不是另一張憑證）。
zh.scenarios.intro: 點一個情境，它就會真的送出，右邊顯示八項檢查的結果。
zh.scenario.impersonation.title: 冒名：只報名字
zh.scenario.impersonation.what: 一支腳本把自己的名字填成「Claude Desktop（Anthropic official client）」，呼叫一般的 MCP 伺服器申請 50 小時 GPU。伺服器沒有別的依據，只能相信這個自稱。
zh.scenario.enroll-today.title: 到職日當天加保
zh.scenario.enroll-today.what: 經辦人的 agent 替 EMP-0101 申報今天加保。八項全過，系統記下是哪個法人、哪個角色、哪個 agent 申報的。
zh.scenario.list-insured.title: 查詢已加保名單
zh.scenario.list-insured.what: 看系統實際記下了什麼：每一筆都有申報者經過驗證的 LEI、角色與 agent 識別碼。
zh.scenario.salary-by-filer.title: 申報角色去調薪
zh.scenario.salary-by-filer.what: 同一個 agent 想調整投保薪資，但它的角色是「申報」，不是「薪資」。
zh.scenario.enroll-15-days.title: 提前 15 天申報
zh.scenario.enroll-15-days.what: 加保日期訂在 15 天後，超過規則允許的「今天到 10 天內」。
zh.scenario.no-credential.title: 不附憑證
zh.scenario.no-credential.what: 同一個呼叫，但拿掉擴充的鍵，就像今天一般的 MCP 呼叫。
zh.scenario.replayed.title: 重送 5 分鐘前的簽章
zh.scenario.replayed.what: 有人攔下一個合法請求，5 分鐘後原封不動再送一次。（目前以 60 秒時效防重送；綁定接收方與一次性編號列在 v0.3 待補。）
zh.scenario.tampered.title: 簽完再竄改
zh.scenario.tampered.what: agent 簽的是薪資等級 3，送出途中被改成 9。
zh.scenario.wrong-key.title: 用別的金鑰冒簽
zh.scenario.wrong-key.what: 攻擊者自稱是這個 agent，但沒有它的私鑰，只好用自己的金鑰簽。
zh.scenario.after-revocation.title: 撤銷後再送
zh.scenario.after-revocation.what: 雇主撤銷經辦人的憑證（真的寫進發證方的日誌），同一個 agent 再申報一次。
zh.revoke.busy: 撤銷中：寫入發證方的交易事件日誌，並等見證節點讀得到（約 15 秒）
zh.revoke.done: 已撤銷。現在送出，第 7 項會拒絕。
zh.reissue.busy: 重發中：發證方簽發新的業務角色憑證（約 1 分鐘）
zh.public.locked: 公開網站上只有展示者可以撤銷或重發憑證。
zh.build.intro: 自己組一個呼叫：選工具、填參數，也可以選一種攻擊方式，再簽章送出。
zh.build.today: 今天是 {today}；規則允許今天到 10 天內。
zh.tool.reserve_gpu_quota: 申請 GPU 配額（一般 MCP 伺服器）
zh.variant.replay: 重送舊簽章（5 分鐘前）
zh.result.empty: 選一個情境，或自己組一個呼叫。結果會顯示在這裡。
zh.result.request.hint: 藍色粗體是本擴充加的鍵（命名空間為暫定），其餘就是一般的 MCP 呼叫。
zh.result.tampered: 簽章時 {field} 是 {signed}，送出時被改成 {sent}。
zh.result.checks.hint: 閘道在呼叫到達系統之前逐項驗證；第一項不通過就停止。
zh.result.server: 勞保模擬系統收到並回應
zh.result.server.blocked: 在閘道就被擋下，系統沒有收到任何東西。
zh.result.server.policy: 這次在程式內驗證，沒有送到系統。
zh.result.impersonation: 伺服器核准了 {approved} 小時（{tier} 等級），依據只有對方自己填的名字「{received}」。
zh.result.impersonation.none: 無法連到冒名示範伺服器，這次沒有量測。
zh.check.credential_present.why: 請求的 _meta 裡要有法人授權的角色憑證（ECR）；沒有就沒有東西可查。
zh.check.freshness.why: 簽章必須在 60 秒內；被攔下的舊簽章晚點再送，會在這裡擋掉。
zh.check.digest.why: 把收到的工具名稱和參數重新計算摘要，必須等於簽章裡的摘要；中途改一個字就不符。
zh.check.signature.source: 簽署者的金鑰事件日誌（見證節點）
zh.check.signature.why: 公鑰從見證節點上簽署者的金鑰日誌取得，絕不從請求本身取得；用別的金鑰簽就過不了。
zh.check.delegation.source: 持有者的金鑰事件日誌
zh.check.delegation.why: 簽章的 agent 必須是憑證持有人（經辦人）在自己的金鑰日誌裡委任的身分。
zh.check.chain.source: 憑證串流與各發證方日誌
zh.check.chain.why: 角色憑證 → 法人憑證 → 發證機構 → 信任根，每一環都要在發證方日誌查得到。示範的信任根是自行設定的，正式環境是 GLEIF。
zh.check.revocation.why: 即時讀取發證方的交易事件日誌；雇主一撤銷，下一次呼叫就被拒。
zh.check.authority: 角色與範圍涵蓋這個工具
zh.check.authority.source: 憑證內容與這次呼叫的參數
zh.check.authority.why: 閘道規則：加保、退保要「申報」角色，日期只能是今天到 10 天內；調薪要「薪資」角色。
zh.layer.missing_credential: 沒有出示憑證：這個工具需要法人授權的角色憑證。
zh.layer.stale_signature: 簽章過期：超過 60 秒，可能是被攔下後重送的舊請求。
zh.layer.digest_mismatch: 參數被改過：送到的內容和簽章時不一樣。
zh.layer.invalid_signature: 簽章不符：不是用 agent 金鑰日誌裡的金鑰簽的。
zh.layer.chain_invalid: 憑證鏈無效：某一環的簽發查不到或不一致。
zh.layer.unknown_root: 不認得的信任根：憑證鏈沒有通到接受的根。
zh.layer.revoked: 憑證已撤銷：雇主已收回經辦人的授權。
zh.layer.role_mismatch: 角色不符：這個工具需要不同的角色。
zh.layer.scope_exceeded: 超出授權範圍：參數超出規則允許的範圍。
zh.layer.unknown: 被拒絕，原因見驗證器原文。
zh.log.title: 稽核紀錄
zh.log.hint: 每一次呼叫：哪個法人、什麼角色、結果。這就是機構導入後會多出來的稽核資料。
zh.tour.1.title: 問題：MCP 只知道對方怎麼自稱
zh.tour.1.text: MCP 讓 AI agent 呼叫各種工具，但協定裡沒有「是哪個法人在行動」。先看一個只報名字就被放行的例子。
zh.tour.2.title: 憑證：法人授權給經辦人的角色
zh.tour.2.text: GLEIF 的 vLEI 體系裡，法人憑證綁定 LEI；業務角色憑證（ECR）是法人授權給經辦人的「勞保申報」角色；agent 是經辦人之下的委任身分。左邊「誰在呼叫」就是這一串。
zh.tour.3.title: 簽章呼叫：一般的 MCP 呼叫，多幾個鍵
zh.tour.3.text: agent 用自己的金鑰替這次呼叫簽章，把憑證和簽章放進 _meta，其餘和一般 MCP 呼叫完全一樣。按下執行，看八項檢查全過。
zh.tour.4.title: 八項檢查：每一項對照自己的可信來源
zh.tour.4.text: 現在同一個呼叫在途中被改了薪資等級。閘道用收到的參數重新計算摘要，和 agent 簽下的摘要不符，所以第 3 項拒絕。若攻擊者連摘要一起改，會在第 4 項失敗：驗簽的公鑰來自見證節點，不是請求。
zh.tour.5.title: 結果：系統記下是誰申報的
zh.tour.5.text: 通過驗證的呼叫才會到系統。查詢名單，每一筆都帶著申報者經過驗證的 LEI、角色與 agent。
zh.tour.6.title: 撤銷：雇主一收回，下一次就被拒
zh.tour.6.text: 按下撤銷，發證方日誌真的記下撤銷；同一個 agent 再送一次，第 7 項拒絕。看完按「重發新憑證」恢復。
zh.footer.text: 每個結果都是真實驗證：KERI 金鑰事件日誌、ACDC 憑證、真的撤銷。申報為模擬，未連接勞保局。信任根為自行設定；正式環境是 GLEIF。
zh.outcome.allowed.plain: 八項全部通過：身分與授權都已驗證，呼叫才送到系統，系統已處理。
zh.result.server.enrol: 已為 {person} 加保：起保日 {date}，投保薪資等級 {grade}。
zh.result.server.adjust: 已調整 {person} 的投保薪資等級為 {grade}。
zh.result.server.list: 這家法人名下共 {count} 筆加保紀錄：
zh.who.names.entity: 示範人力股份有限公司（虛構）
zh.error.network: 連不到展示伺服器（console）。請確認它正在執行，再試一次。
zh.error.person_ref: 員工代號要是 EMP- 加四位數字，例如 EMP-0101（全部虛構）。
zh.error.start_date: 請填一個真實的加保日期。
zh.error.end_date: 請填一個真實的退保日期。
zh.error.salary_grade: 投保薪資等級要是 1 到 60 的整數。
zh.revoke.unconfirmed: 撤銷已寫入，但 30 秒內還沒讀回（閘道可能未連線）。稍後送出一次呼叫即可確認。
zh.scenarios.needs.revoked: 要先按上面的「撤銷經辦人憑證」才能執行
zh.build.person: 員工代號是虛構的：EMP- 加四位數字。
zh.system.not_enrolled: {person} 並未由這家雇主（統一編號 {ubn}）加保，所以無法退保或調薪。
zh.outcome.allowed.policy: 八項全部通過。這次是在程式內驗證，呼叫沒有送到系統。
zh.outcome.allowed.refusedBySystem: 身分與授權驗證通過（八項全過），但系統依業務規則拒絕了這筆申報。
zh.outcome.refused.noReport: 閘道拒絕了這次呼叫，但沒有附上驗證報告（驗證服務可能未啟動）。沒有報告就不算通過。
zh.outcome.unavailable.plain: 連不到驗證閘道，這次沒有任何驗證結果。
zh.result.without: 沒有這個擴充時：今天的 MCP 伺服器不會檢查這些，這個呼叫會照樣被執行。
zh.result.server.notReceived: 勞保模擬系統：沒有收到請求
zh.result.server.unreachable: 勞保模擬系統：閘道未連線
zh.result.server.list.one: 這家法人名下共 1 筆加保紀錄：
zh.result.checks.timing: 耗時為實測值。第 2–4 項共用同一次金鑰日誌讀取，所以數字相同；第 5 項用的是同一份已讀到的日誌。
zh.footer.namespace: 命名空間 org.gleif.vlei 為暫定、示範用，未經 GLEIF 審查或認可。
zh.ev.title: 閘道證據
zh.ev.subtitle: 每一個 tools/call，不論來自 claude.ai、Claude Desktop／Code 或這個 console：閘道驗了什麼、讀了什麼、怎麼決定。
zh.ev.live: 即時 · 每 2 秒更新
zh.ev.banner: 勞保系統為模擬；所有身分皆為虛構。本頁不顯示憑證內容、私鑰或參數值，只顯示名稱與識別碼。
zh.ev.empty: 閘道還沒有收到任何 tools/call。從 claude.ai 或 Claude Desktop 呼叫一次，這裡就會出現。
zh.ev.s1.args: 參數名稱（只列名稱，不列值）
zh.ev.s1.none: 沒有任何 vLEI 欄位：這個呼叫沒有附憑證，也沒有簽章。
zh.ev.s2.none: 沒有驗證報告：這個請求裡沒有可驗證的呼叫。
zh.ev.s3: ③ 向見證節點讀了什麼
zh.ev.s3.hint: 每一行都是一次實際的讀取：誰的金鑰事件日誌（KEL）、從哪個見證節點、花了多久。撤銷與否看的是發行者自己的 KEL：錨定的事件 0 是簽發，事件 1 是撤銷。
zh.ev.s3.none: 這次沒有讀取見證節點：在讀取之前就拒絕了。
zh.ev.rec.unread: 這次沒有讀到它發行者的 KEL
zh.ev.s4: ④ Schema 對照 GLEIF 官方
zh.ev.s4.match: 與 GLEIF 官方 {type} schema 相同
zh.ev.s4.nomatch: 不是 GLEIF 發布的 vLEI schema
zh.ev.s4.none: 沒有出示憑證，沒有 schema 可比對。
zh.ev.s4.forged: schema 跟官方一模一樣，問題出在信任根：偽造的人可以照抄 schema，抄不了根。
zh.ev.out.allow: 放行：帶著驗證過的身分（LEI {lei}、角色 {role}）轉給勞保模擬系統。
zh.ev.out.deny.grpc: 在閘道就拒絕，勞保模擬系統沒有收到。呼叫端收到的是 MCP 工具錯誤（HTTP 200），第一行就是原因，所以 Claude 能照實說明。
zh.ev.out.deny.http: 在閘道就拒絕（HTTP 403），勞保模擬系統沒有收到。
zh.ev.witnesses.reads: {n} 個見證節點回答（共 {reads} 次讀取）

en.app.title: MCP × vLEI — interactive demonstration
en.app.subtitle: How an AI agent calling a government system proves which legal entity it acts for, in what role, on whose authority
en.banner.simulated: Simulated: the labour-insurance filing is not connected to the Bureau of Labor Insurance. All identities are fictional. The root of trust is self-hosted for demonstration. The KERI key logs, ACDC credentials and revocation are real.
en.who.title: Who is calling
en.who.note: The legal entity gave its handler the labour-insurance filing role (an ECR credential); the handler delegated to the agent in the handler's own key event log (a KERI delegation, not another credential).
en.scenarios.intro: Pick a scenario: it is sent for real, and the eight checks appear on the right.
en.scenarios.expect.self-asserted: Expected: granted on a name alone
en.scenario.impersonation.title: Impersonation: a name is all it takes
en.scenario.impersonation.what: A script fills in its own name as “Claude Desktop (Anthropic official client)” and asks an ordinary MCP server for 50 GPU hours. With nothing else to go on, the server believes the name.
en.scenario.enroll-today.title: Enrol on the start date
en.scenario.enroll-today.what: The handler's agent enrols EMP-0101 from today. All eight pass; the system records which entity, role and agent filed it.
en.scenario.list-insured.title: List the insured
en.scenario.list-insured.what: See what the system actually recorded: every record carries the filer's verified LEI, role and agent identifier.
en.scenario.salary-by-filer.title: A filer adjusts a salary
en.scenario.salary-by-filer.what: The same agent tries to change an insured salary, but its role is filing, not payroll.
en.scenario.enroll-15-days.title: Filing fifteen days ahead
en.scenario.enroll-15-days.what: A start date fifteen days out — beyond the “today to ten days ahead” the rule allows.
en.scenario.no-credential.title: No credential
en.scenario.no-credential.what: The same call without the extension's keys — an ordinary MCP call, as today.
en.scenario.replayed.title: Replay a five-minute-old signature
en.scenario.replayed.what: Someone captures a valid request and sends it again, unchanged, five minutes later. (Replay is limited by a 60-second window today; binding the recipient and a one-time nonce are v0.3 work.)
en.scenario.tampered.title: Tamper after signing
en.scenario.tampered.what: The agent signed salary grade 3; on the way it is changed to 9.
en.scenario.wrong-key.title: Sign with someone else's key
en.scenario.wrong-key.what: An attacker claims to be the agent without its private key, and signs with a key of their own.
en.scenario.after-revocation.title: After revocation
en.scenario.after-revocation.what: The employer revokes the handler's credential — written to the issuer's log — and the same agent files again.
en.revoke.busy: Revoking: written to the issuer's transaction event log, then waiting until the witness serves it (about 15 s)
en.revoke.done: Revoked. Send now and check 7 refuses.
en.reissue.busy: Issuing: the issuer signs a new role credential (about a minute)
en.public.locked: On the public site only the presenter can revoke or re-issue the credential.
en.build.intro: Build a call yourself: choose a tool, fill in its arguments, optionally choose an attack, then sign and send.
en.build.today: Today is {today}; the rule allows today to ten days ahead.
en.tool.reserve_gpu_quota: Reserve GPU quota (an ordinary MCP server)
en.variant.tamper: Tamper with the arguments after signing
en.result.empty: Pick a scenario, or build a call. The result appears here.
en.result.request.hint: In bold navy: the keys this extension adds (provisional namespace). Everything else is an ordinary MCP call.
en.result.checks.hint: The gateway checks each in turn before the call reaches the system, and stops at the first failure.
en.result.server: The labour-insurance simulator received it and answered
en.result.server.blocked: Stopped at the gateway: the system received nothing.
en.result.server.policy: Verified in process this time; nothing was sent to the system.
en.result.server.filedBy: Filer as the system recorded it
en.result.impersonation: The server granted {approved} hours ({tier} tier) on the strength of a name the caller typed: “{received}”.
en.result.impersonation.none: The impersonation server could not be reached; nothing was measured.
en.check.credential_present.why: The request's _meta must carry the role credential (ECR) a legal entity granted. Without it there is nothing to check.
en.check.freshness.why: Signed within the last 60 seconds: a captured signature sent again later stops here.
en.check.digest: the arguments match what was signed
en.check.digest.why: The tool name and arguments are hashed again and compared with the signed digest: one changed character and they differ.
en.check.signature.source: the signer's key event log, from the witness
en.check.signature.why: The public key comes from the signer's key log at the witness — never from the request. A signature by any other key fails.
en.check.delegation.why: The agent that signed must be delegated by the credential's holder, the handler, in the handler's own key log.
en.check.chain: the credential chain reaches an accepted root
en.check.chain.source: the credential stream and the issuers' logs
en.check.chain.why: Role credential → legal entity → issuer → root: every link must be anchored in its issuer's log. The demo's root is self-configured; in production it is GLEIF's.
en.check.revocation.why: The issuers' transaction event logs are read live: once the employer revokes, the next call is refused.
en.check.authority: the role and scope cover this tool
en.check.authority.source: the credential and this call's arguments
en.check.authority.why: The gateway's rules: enrolment and withdrawal need the filing role and a date from today to ten days ahead; a salary change needs the payroll role.
en.layer.missing_credential: No credential: this tool requires a role credential from a legal entity.
en.layer.stale_signature: Stale signature: older than 60 seconds — possibly a captured request sent again.
en.layer.digest_mismatch: Arguments changed: what arrived is not what was signed.
en.layer.invalid_signature: Invalid signature: not made with the key in the agent's key log.
en.layer.chain_invalid: Broken chain: a link's issuance cannot be found or does not match.
en.layer.unknown_root: Unknown root: the chain does not end at an accepted root.
en.layer.revoked: Revoked: the employer withdrew the handler's credential.
en.layer.role_mismatch: Wrong role: this tool requires a different role.
en.layer.scope_exceeded: Out of scope: the arguments fall outside what the rule allows.
en.layer.unknown: Refused; the verifier's words give the reason.
en.log.title: Audit log
en.log.hint: Every call: which legal entity, what role, what result — the audit record an institution gains.
en.tour.1.title: The problem: MCP knows only what a caller calls itself
en.tour.1.text: MCP lets an AI agent call any tool, but nothing in it says which legal entity is acting. First, a caller granted on a name alone.
en.tour.2.title: The credentials: a role the legal entity granted
en.tour.2.text: In GLEIF's vLEI ecosystem the legal entity's credential binds its LEI; the Engagement Context Role (ECR) is the labour-insurance filing role the entity gave its handler; the agent is a delegated identifier under the handler. “Who is calling”, on the left, is that chain.
en.tour.3.title: A signed call: an ordinary MCP call, a few more keys
en.tour.3.text: The agent signs this call with its own key and puts the credential and the signature in _meta; everything else is an ordinary MCP call. Run it and watch all eight pass.
en.tour.4.title: Eight checks, each against its own source of truth
en.tour.4.text: Now the same call has its salary grade changed on the way. The gateway hashes the arguments it received; the result differs from the digest the agent signed, so check 3 refuses. Change the digest too and check 4 fails: the key that verifies the signature comes from the witness, not the request.
en.tour.5.title: The result: the system records who filed
en.tour.5.text: Only a verified call reaches the system. List the insured: every record carries the filer's verified LEI, role and agent.
en.tour.6.title: Revocation: withdrawn by the employer, refused the next time
en.tour.6.text: Revoke, and the issuer's log records it for real; the same agent sends again and check 7 refuses. Afterwards, “Issue a fresh credential” restores it.
en.footer.text: Every result is a real verification: KERI key event logs, ACDC credentials, real revocation. The filing is simulated, not connected to the Bureau of Labor Insurance. The root of trust is self-configured; in production it is GLEIF's.
en.outcome.allowed.plain: All eight passed: identity and authority verified, and only then did the call reach the system, which processed it.
en.error.network: The demonstration server (console) cannot be reached. Check that it is running, then try again.
en.error.person_ref: An employee reference is EMP- and four digits, e.g. EMP-0101 (all fictional).
en.error.salary_grade: The salary grade is a whole number from 1 to 60.
en.revoke.unconfirmed: The revocation was written, but not yet read back within 30 seconds (the gateway may be down). Send a call to confirm.
en.scenarios.needs.revoked: Revoke the handler's credential above first
en.build.person: Employee references are fictional: EMP- and four digits.
en.system.not_enrolled: {person} is not enrolled by this employer (統一編號 {ubn}), so there is nothing to withdraw or adjust.
en.outcome.allowed.policy: All eight passed. This time the verification ran in process, and the call was not sent to a system.
en.outcome.allowed.refusedBySystem: Identity and authority verified — all eight passed — but the system refused the filing on a business rule.
en.outcome.refused.noReport: The gateway refused the call without a verification report (the verifier may be down). Without a report nothing counts as passed.
en.outcome.unavailable.plain: The gateway could not be reached: there is no verification result.
en.result.without: Without this extension: today's MCP servers check none of this, and this call would simply be executed.
en.result.server.unreachable: The labour-insurance simulator: the gateway is not answering
en.result.checks.timing: Times are measured. Checks 2–4 share one key-log read, so their numbers are the same; check 5 reuses the log already read.
en.footer.namespace: The namespace org.gleif.vlei is provisional and for demonstration; it has not been reviewed or endorsed by GLEIF.
en.ev.title: Gateway evidence
en.ev.subtitle: Every tools/call, from claude.ai, Claude Desktop or Code, or this console: what the gateway checked, what it read, what it decided.
en.ev.banner: The labour-insurance system is simulated; every identity is fictional. This page never shows a credential, a key or an argument's value: only names and identifiers.
en.ev.empty: The gateway has not received a tools/call yet. Make one from claude.ai or Claude Desktop and it appears here.
en.ev.s1.none: No vLEI field at all: the call carried no credential and no signature.
en.ev.s2.none: No verification report: the request held no call to verify.
en.ev.s3: ③ What was read from the witnesses
en.ev.s3.hint: Each line is one actual read: whose key event log (KEL), from which witness, how long. Revocation is read from the issuer's own KEL: anchored event 0 is the issuance, event 1 the revocation.
en.ev.s3.none: No witness was read this time: the call was refused before any read.
en.ev.rec.unread: its issuer's KEL was not read this time
en.ev.s4: ④ Schemas against GLEIF's published set
en.ev.s4.none: No credential presented: no schema to compare.
en.ev.s4.forged: The schemas match exactly; what fails is the root. A forger can copy a schema, not a root.
en.ev.out.allow: Allowed: forwarded to the labour-insurance simulator with the verified identity (LEI {lei}, role {role}).
en.ev.out.deny.grpc: Refused at the gateway; the simulator received nothing. The caller got an MCP tool error (HTTP 200) whose first line is the reason, so Claude can explain it.
en.ev.out.deny.http: Refused at the gateway (HTTP 403); the simulator received nothing.
en.ev.error: The evidence log could not be read: {message}
en.ev.via.unknown: — (an older record; its source was not recorded)
